what_this_file_is: An integrity-recovery record binding each companion artifact in RUN-QSP-33b442-S5/ to its source. Written under CORR-20260917-8b80cc route.D2_route_S5, task TASK-20260917-93192a.
the_defect_this_repairs: make_report.py DID run and produced metrics.json and report.md in this directory. What was missed is the CAPTURE, not the execution: the original invocation wrote none of the five companion artifacts the run-package layout requires.
what_was_done: The step was RE-EXECUTED under the experiment's own run wrapper (implementation/runlib.py), with all output directed to a scratch directory outside experiments/. The re-execution's metrics.json was then compared BYTE FOR BYTE with the committed metrics.json in this directory. Only on byte-identity were these five companions copied in. Nothing was reconstructed and nothing was written from a manifest field.
why_a_re_execution_and_not_a_reconstruct: Stage 5 TAKES NO MEASUREMENT: it reads five frozen raw-result.json files and evaluates the M7 table in closed form. A re-execution therefore cannot move a measured value, and its agreement with the committed metrics.json is a free determinism check. Reconstructing stdout.log from the manifest would instead have produced a file describing output nobody captured.

budget.reason: CORR-20260917-8b80cc route.D2_route_S5.budget_ruling: specification.yaml budget.note scopes the run budget to the five compute stages plus one re-invocation for infrastructure failure. Stage 5 is not a compute stage and takes no measurement, and both RUN-QSP-33b442-S0 and -S5 recorded that reading in counts_against_maximum_runs_reason BEFORE this defect was raised. The six counted invocations remain S1, S1B, S2, S2B, S3, S4.

re_execution.why_a_copy_of_the_script_was_invoked: make_report.py resolves its output directory from its own file location and does NOT honour the QSP_RUNS_DIR override, so invoking the committed copy in place would have overwritten the committed metrics.json. A byte-identical copy of the script was therefore rooted at a scratch tree with the five frozen input run directories copied in verbatim. The committed experiments/ tree was never written to by the re-execution.
re_execution.driver_note: The driver lives in the session scratchpad, outside the repository, and is not part of the frozen implementation. It only creates the run wrapper, invokes make_report.py as a subprocess, and records the comparison; it computes nothing.

determinism_check.meaning: The committed metrics.json reproduces EXACTLY from the frozen inputs at commit edd7541b320cfe2ece107b51a971d2eda09e12b9. This adds evidence about reproducibility; it is not a new measurement.

files_not_touched.statement: manifest.yaml, metrics.json and report.md in this directory are byte-identical at their original paths and were not read for modification, edited, regenerated or replaced.

what_this_does_not_assert: NOT that these companions are the original invocation's captured output. They are not, and the file name says so first.
NOT that any measurement changed. Stage 5 takes none.
NOT that RUN-QSP-33b442-S5 is a new run. It is the same run id; only its companion capture was recovered.
